hints.title: Subtree Representation
hints.text: Represent each subtree by a representation of its root value together with representations of its left and right subtrees.

hints.title: Post-Order Identification
hints.text: Traverse bottom up so child identifiers are ready before building the identifier for the parent.

hints.title: Frequency Recording
hints.text: Use a mapping to count occurrences of each serialized subtree signature. When a signature count reaches two, add the current node to the collection of duplicate roots.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the tree
complexity.notes: Subtree serialization via post-order traversal recording frequency signatures.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair of subtrees directly costs quadratic O(N^2) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing subtree serialized signatures avoids repeated structural traversals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Serialize subtrees bottom-up and record each duplicate root exactly once.
